title: Circles Japan Visit Stinner Frameworks
content:
In the latest video from Stinner Frameworks, the team sits down with Shige from Circles Japan and Sim Works during his visit to Stinner’s Santa Barbara workshop.

In this video, Aaron and Shige discuss their new partnership bringing Stinner Frameworks custom hand-built bicycles to Japan. Shige shares the story of Circles, from its origins in Nagoya nearly 20 years ago to the opening of Circles Tailored, a shop dedicated to custom handmade bikes.

The video dives into Japanese cycling culture—from everyday commuting (Mama Chari) to the growing popularity of bikepacking and gravel riding, while discussing Sim Works, Circles’ iconic in-house components brand showcasing Japanese craftsmanship with brands like Nitto, Honjo, and Panaracer.

The post Circles Japan Visit Stinner Frameworks appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
